rule: Deployed frames are the only ones this client sends or completes on. Unresolved frames are captured from the contract so they are not reinvented. Placeholder angle-bracket values are not secrets, trips, or channel names.

deployed.evidence: §11.2 hello is always v:1 and, with the durable flag on, adds durable and durableVersion 2. type is how this client already recognizes a v1 hello.
§11.2 client opts into v2 per-join. Ownership is a client-chosen secret in pass (or password, or nick#secret). This client sends pass only, never nick#secret, so the secret is not in the logged nick.
§11.3 welcome sets replay to an empty array and inboxAuth true. Inbox count field names are not in the evidence.
§11.3 backlog rows stream as delivery frames. Ack requires deliveryId and leaseGeneration. Other body fields are not pinned.
§11.3 the client pages with pull. No cursor. The limit field name is not in the evidence, so the frame is only v and type.
§11.3 pull_result reports count, queued, delivered, dead. Page again while queued > 0.
§11.2 ack is v 2, type ack, deliveryId, leaseGeneration.
§11.3 accepted carries messageId and ingressId and means stored, not adapter-processed.
§11.3 a connected v2 socket is told type dead. deliveryId on that frame is not pinned.
§11.3 older generation is lease_fenced. The envelope is an error code in this fixture; ack_result carrying the same code is also accepted.
Explicit send rejection after bytes have left. retryAfterMs is the server delay in milliseconds. This frame is not an accept receipt. A missing delay uses the client default, and the delay is capped.

unresolved.why: §11.2: no versions array exists in server src. Do not pin a designed session from this hello alone.
§11.2: no bind frame. Ownership is the owner secret at join.
§11.2: no token is issued. binding must not be stored or treated as authorization. Trips stay evidence.
§11.2: client_msg_id is not a server idempotency key. A retry after a missed accepted creates a second message. The id is local only.
§11.2: no leased batch and no lease id. A lease is deliveryId plus leaseGeneration.
§11.2: ack is deliveryId plus leaseGeneration, not lease plus ids.
§11.2: no acked-count frame. Completion is ack_result.
§11.2: no since_seq resume. Paging is pull while pull_result.queued > 0.
